title: Collegeboxes vs Dorm Room Movers at Texas A&M
description: Which pickup to book at Texas A&M, from the prices and dates each company lists.
intro: Both companies will pick up a dorm room and bring it back. The bills are different. Collegeboxes' own school page disagrees with itself about whether room pickup is available.
Compare the lines, then open the source before you pay. Neither company is an official Texas A&M service.

rows.label: Standard box, 4 months
rows.note: Collegeboxes' $56 is on the national price list. Dorm Room Movers' box is the Medium tier on the Texas A&M pricing feed.

rows.label: Fee charged before any box is picked up

left.text: National list says no registration fee. Supply kit is $39.99 plus tax if you buy it.

right.text: Not on the public page. Featured dates require a sign-in.
right.sourceLabel: Dorm Room Movers Texas A&M pricing

left.text: U-Haul at 2813 Texas Ave, College Station.

right.text: A climate-protected warehouse. Street address not published.
right.sourceLabel: Dorm Room Movers Texas A&M page

takeaway: On the published lists, five standard boxes for four months are $280 at Collegeboxes' national box rate, before any handling fee. The same five DRM boxes are $455 list, or $409.50 if you prepay, and then the $49.99 registration fee sits on top. Checked Nov 22, 2026.

That comparison only holds if Collegeboxes will actually pick the boxes up. The Texas A&M page says full-service moving is currently unavailable and, on the same page, lists pickup dates. Ask them which sentence is the booking rule.
Dorm Room Movers is the clearer per-item menu. Collegeboxes is the one that names the building.
